title: Normal Chip H3K23ac BA
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, take 1 × 10⁶ cells, add 1 % formaldehyde and incubate for 14 min; then quench the fixation by adding glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate for an additional 1 min.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, catalog 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog 303410); afterwards harvest the cells by scraping them from the plates.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: add PBS + inhibitors + sodium butyrate, mix, remove.
Scrape cells from plates to collect.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei using Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the harvested cells to a Covaris E220 tube and run the instrument at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 %, 200 cycles/burst for 4.5 min to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each IP, use an equal amount of chromatin; add 2 µg of the specific antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, catalog 88802); perform the immunoprecipitation as described in Arrigoni 2018, omitting any barcode ligation and pooling steps.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin and DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the input chromatin with a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific); after IP, quantify the recovered DNA using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLabs, catalog E7645S); assess library quality and quantity with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
